name: lendly
description: LENDLY hyperlocal peer-to-peer borrowing and rental platform

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @lendly/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @lendly/api" "npm run dev -w @lendly/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lendly/shared && npm run build -w @lendly/api && npm run build -w @lendly/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @lendly/shared && npm run typecheck -w @lendly/api && npm run typecheck -w @lendly/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @lendly/api && npm run test -w @lendly/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @lendly/api && npm run lint -w @lendly/web
